what: Pick a style and generate a band in one press. Chords, bass, drums and melody stay in sync and play off each other. In GLO Live, use the keys to solo parts, cue fills and drops, and play effects over the groove.
author: Chase DeAnda
sounds: CC0: four DX7 banks from Aquanode Soundscapes by aquanodemusic (CC0-1.0). Own: RAKT boot chime WAV rendered by the firmware synthesizer.
